expectations.text: Identifies that pause() alone on background leaves the AVPlay/decoder (and DRM) session held, and that the platform reclaiming/invalidating that resource while backgrounded is why the next play fails until a full relaunch
expectations.evidence: pause() alone leaves decoder+DRM+overlay held; platform reclaims while bg

expectations.text: The fix tears the player down on background: avplay.stop() followed by avplay.close() (releasing the AVPlay instance), not just pause()
expectations.evidence: teardown: stop() then close() then setListener empty then null handle

expectations.text: The fix persists playback position on background and rebuilds the player (open/prepareAsync + seek to saved position) on return to foreground, instead of calling play() on the torn-down/stale instance
expectations.evidence: persist playhead on hidden; rebuild open/setDrm/prepareAsync/seekTo on visible

expectations.text: Frames this as the general cross-platform rule: release the media pipeline and GPU/DRM resources when leaving the foreground (signalled by visibilitychange->hidden on Tizen)
expectations.evidence: framed as general rule: release media pipeline + GPU/DRM on leaving foreground

expectations.text: Does not misdiagnose the root cause as a buffering, network, or listener-ordering bug unrelated to holding the decoder/DRM session across background
expectations.evidence: suspend()/restore() will not survive live-TV case; onerror -> rebuild
